/de ltar bu'i tshad med pa bzhi po 'di rgyal sras rnams la rang bzhin rtags par skye ba dang*/ goms pa las skye ba dang*/ yul mthong ba las skye ba dang*/ mi mthun phyogs nyams pa las skye bar/ de nyid las/ snying rje'i bdag nyid can gyi brtse ba 'di/ /rang bzhin dang ni so sor brtags pa dang*/ /de sngon goms par byas dang ldan pa dang*/ /mi mthun phyogs nyams rnam dag thob pa bzhi/ /zhes so/ / rgyu mthun gyi phan yon ni/ rgyu mthun gyi 'bras bu la gnyis las/ rgyu mthun byed pas de nyid byed pa dang*/ /myong bas mi mthun phyogs bral bde ba 'thob/ / byed pa rgyu mthun pas tshad med bzhi rtag tu sgom par skye la/ myong ba rgyu mthun pas gnod sems dang*/ rnam 'tshe dang*/ mi dga' ba dang*/ chags sdang rnams med par skye'o/ / dbang gi phan yon ni/ bdag po'am/ dbang gis yid 'ong bde zhing rab dga'i yul/ /'gro ba mthun cing 'byor pas brgyan par skye/ /byams pas yul yid du 'ong ba dang*/ snying rjes bde ba dang*/ dga' bas sman dang me tog la sogs pa mang zhing skyid la 'byor pa dang*/ btang snyoms kyis skye dgu mthun zhing gnod pa med par skye'o/ / byed pa'i phan yon ni/ skyes bu/ byed pas bzhi po ches cher rab 'phel bas/ / rang gzhan don gnyis 'byor pa lhun grub 'gyur/ /tshad med pa bzhi bsgoms pa las yang 'phel ba'i bsod nams kyis bde ba dang legs pa 'grub pa yin no/ / byams pa'i phan yon ni/ gzhan yang*/ byams pas zhe sdang med cing longs spyod rdzogs/ /me long ye shes rab tu thob par 'gyur/ /longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku ni mtshan dpes brgyan/ /de'ang byams pas zhe sdang gnas gyur me long lta bu'i ye shes mngon du gyur nas longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku thob pa yin te/ pad+ma rtse mo las/ byams pas zhe sdang gnas su dag /me long ye shes longs spyod rdzogs/ /zhes so/ / snying rje'i phan yon ni/

yang snying rjes 'dod chags med cing chos kyi sku/ /so sor rtog pa'i ye shes mngon du byed/ /chos kyi sku ni stobs sogs ma 'dres chos/ /snying rjes 'dod chags dag pa so sor rtog pa'i ye shes dang chos sku thob par/ de nyid las/ snying rjes 'dod chags gnas su dag /kun rtog ye shes chos kyi sku/ /zhes so/ / dga' ba'i phan yon ni/ yang dga' bas phrag dog med cing sprul pa'i sku/ /bya grub ye shes dam pa thob par 'gyur/ /sprul pa'i sku ni ma nges sna tshogs gzugs/ /lhun gyis grub pa'i sku ste phrin las yin/ /dga' ba tshad med pas phrin las phun sum tshogs pa'i rang bzhin bya ba grub pa'i ye shes thob cing*/ phrag dog dag nas sprul pa'i sku mngon du byed de/ de nyid las/ dga' bas phrag dog gnas su dag /bya grub ye shes sprul pa'i sku/ /mdzad pa lhun grub dam pa'o/ /zhes so/ / btang snyoms kyi phan yon ni/ yang*/ btang snyoms nga rgyal rmongs med ngo bo nyid/ / mnyam nyid chos dbyings ye shes mngon du byed/ /ngo bo nyid sku chos nyid spros dang bral/ /btang snyoms kyis nga rgyal dang gti mug gnas su dag nas mnyam pa nyid dang chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes grub ste ngo bo nyid kyi sku mi 'gyur bas rdo rje dang*/ mngon par byang chub pa'i sku mngon du byed par/ de nyid las/ btang snyoms btang snyoms chen po yis/ /nga rgyal gti mug gnas su dag /mnyam nyid chos dbyings ye shes bdag /byang chub rdo rje'i sku nyid do/ /zhes so/ tshad med pa'i 'di dag gi byed las kyang bzhi las/ ma chags pa'i rang bzhin ni/ mdo sde'i rgyan las/ snying rjes zin pa'i brtser ldan rnams/ /zhi la'ang yid ni mi gnas na/ /'jig rten bde dang rang srog la/ /chags par 'gyur ba smos ci dgos/ /zhes so/ /rang bde mi 'dod pa ni/ de nyid las/ snying rjes sdug bsngal dag gis sdug bsngal ba/ /bde ma bskyed par gang gis bde bar 'gyur/

/de phyir brtse dang ldan pas gzhan bde ba/ /bskyed nas rang nyid bde bar byed pa yin/ /zhes so/ /gzhan bde zil gyis gnon pa ni/ de nyid las/ brtse bas bskyed pa'i sdug bsngal 'jig rten gyi/ /bde ba thams cad zil gyis gnon 'gyur zhing*/ /don byas rnams kyang de dang mi ldan gang*/ /de las ngo mtshar che ba ci zhig yod/ /ces pa dang*/ slob spring las/ 'gro ba sdug bsngal mi bzad mang pos dbang med skyabs med 'dir/ /gzhan gyi don du sdug bsngal gang de bde zhes skyes mchog gsung*/ /skad cig gzhan bkres skom dang tsha ngal phral bas rang byas pa/ /des dga' gang zhig de dang 'dra bar 'di yang gang zhig yod/ /gzhan phan bde ba bskyed par brtson pas dga' ba rnyed pa gang*/ /de ni yul bde'i longs spyod lhur len rnams kyis ji ltar yang*/ /gzhon bdes mi 'thong mi dbang 'byor pa'i yo byad rnams kyis min/ /chung mas ma yin gzhan min lha gnas lha min 'gro bar min/ /zhes so/ /'khor ba la mi skyo ba'i byed las ni/ snga ma las/ snying rje blo mchog 'khor bar btags pa yi/ sdug bsngal bdag nyid kun dang bdag med pa'ang*/ /rnam par shes nas skyo bar mi 'gyur zhing*/ /nyes pas rab gnod par yang mi 'gyur ro/ /zhes so/ /de lta bu'i don dang ldan pa'i skyes bu dam pa de'i tshad med pa ni 'jig rten las 'das shing kha na ma tho ba med pa yin te/ de nyid las/ chags pa gang de kha na ma tho ba/ /med dang 'jig rten 'das pa yod ma yin/ /blo ldan rnams kyi brtse bas byams pa ni/ kha na ma tho med cing 'jig rten 'das/ /zhes te/ pha ma bu tsha la byams pa chags pa yin la/ sems dpa' sems can la chags pa de lta bu ma yin te 'khor ba las sgrol ba'i phyir ro zhes pa'o/ kha na ma tho ba med pa ni/ sdug bsngal ba'i sems can 'khor ba las sgrol ba'i phyir te/ de nyid las/ sdug bsngal dba' rgal che dang mi shes pa'i/ /mun pa che la brten par gyur pa yi/

/'jig rten 'dren pa'i thabs gang yin pa de/ /ji ltar kha na ma tho med mi 'gyur/ /zhes so/ /'jig rten las 'das pa yin te/ nyan rang la'ang med pa'i byams pa la sogs yin pa'i phyir te/ de nyid las/ 'jig rten byang chub rang sangs rgyas pa yi/ /dgra bcom rnams la'ang byams pa de med na/ /de las gzhan la smos kyang ci dgos pa/ /ji ltar 'jig rten 'das pa ma yin 'gyur/ /zhes so/ /tshad med bzhi ma bsgoms na nyes pa du ma yod de/ de nyid las/ byang chub sems dpa' gnod sems dang*/ /rnam 'tshe mi dga' gnod sems dang*/ /'dod pa'i 'dod chags dang ldan pas/ / nyes pa rnam pa mang la reg /ces so/ /de'ang 'dod pa'i sar skye ba la 'dod pa'i 'dod chags zer la/ gong ma gnyis su skye ba la srid pa'i 'dod chags zer te/ mdzod las/ khams gnyis las skyes srid 'dod chags/ /zhes so/ /nyon mongs pa 'phel ba'i nyes pa ni tshad med de/ snga ma las/ nyon mongs rnams ni bdag 'joms sems can 'joms shing tshul khrims 'joms/ /nyams bcas rnyed pas dman zhing srung dang de bzhin ston pas smad/ /rtsod bcas mi snyan de ni gzhan du mi khom rnams su skye/ /thob dang ma thob nyams pas yid la sdug bsngal chen po 'thob/ /ces so/ /thob pa 'di'i bde ba dang ma thob pa phyi ma'i bde ba las nyams pa'o/ /tshad med pa bzhi bsgoms pa'i phan yon ni/ de ltar bu'i nyes pa med pa dang sems can gyi don du srid pa 'dzin yang*/ nyon mongs pa can gyi 'khor ba ma yin pas sdug bsngal mi 'byung ba ste/ de nyid las/ nyes pa 'di kun byams sogs la/ /legs par gnas la mi 'byung ste/ /nyon mongs can min sems can gyi/ /don du 'khor ba yongs mi gtong*/ /zhes so/ / yon tan la bsngags pa ni/ tshul/ de ltar byams sogs yon tan mtha' yas shing*/ /mtshungs bral lha mi'i ston pas rab bsngags mdzad/ /ji skad du/ dpal phreng gi mdo las/ gang gis tshad med bzhi bsgoms pa/

de ni bde gshegs kun gyis dgongs/ /kun du yon tan tshad med de/ /nam mkha'i lam las rab 'das pa'o/ /zhes so/ / tshad med bzhi rgyal ba'i gshegs shul du bstan pa ni/ tshad med pa bzhi po/ de dag mi bden lam de phyin ci log /ston pa gzhan la skyabs song lam ngan yin/ /des gzung lam ni thar pa dri ma med/ /dus gsum rgyal ba snga phyi'i gshegs shul yin/ ji skad du/ sa'i stod 'grel las/ tshad med pa 'di bzhi ni thar par 'gro ba'i lam ste/ gzhan du na lam log pa'o zhes bshad do/ / dam pa gnyis thob tshul bstan pa ni/ 'di ltar/ rgyu yi theg pas sa bon myu gu bzhin/ /thabs shes sku gnyis bskyed par 'dod na yang*/ /'bras bu'i theg pas sku yi sgrib pa gnyis/ /sel byed rkyen gyi rnam par khas len pas/ / thabs nyid snying rje tshad med lam la brten/ /don la gcig ste stong nyid snying rje can/ /rgyu 'bras gnyis kas mthun par nyams su len/ /'di ltar mtshan nyid kyi theg pa phal cher las/ tshogs gnyis sku gnyis kyi skyed byed kyi rgyur khas len te/ rigs pa drug cu pa las/ dge ba 'di yis skye bo kun/ / bsod nams ye shes tshogs bsags te/ /bsod nams ye shes las byung ba'i/ /dam pa gnyis ni thob par shog /ces pa dang*/ gsang sngags las/ sku yi sgrib pa gnyis sel ba la tshogs gnyis thabs dang shes rab zab mos nyams su len par 'dod pas rkyen du khas len pa gnyis ka mthun te/ stong nyid snying rje'i snying po can bsgrub pa'i phyir ro/ / de ltar bsgoms pa'i don bsdu ba ni/ 'di ltar/ gzhan yang thog med dge ba sa bon tshul/ /ma byas ye nas gnas par mdo las gsungs/ /de dang sku gsum ye ldan glo bur gyi/ /sgrib pas bsgribs te sel 'dod sngags nyid mtshungs/ / mdor na mdo rgyud lam rnams gcig nyid du/ /mkhas grub rnams kyis phyi nang bshad pa mdzad/ /de phyir rgyal sras dam pa'i rjes 'gro zhing*/

/tshad med rnam pa bzhi la 'bad par mdzod/ /'di ltar/ bka' tha ma las khams rang bzhin gyis dag pa yon tan ye ldan du yod la/ lam nyams su blangs dus yon tan skye ba ltar snang bar khas len pa dang*/ sngags las rang bzhin gyi dkyil 'khor 'gro ba kun la gnas par 'og tu 'chad pa gnyis khyad med pas gzhi gcig la/ lam yang thabs shes tshogs gnyis su gcig la/ 'bras bu yang sku dang ye shes su gcig pas na sngon gyi slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas la sogs pas phyi nang du bshad mdzad pa yin no/ /de bas na tshad med pa bzhi bsgom pa la 'bad par mdzod cig ces pa'o/ / spyi don bcu pa skabs kyi dge ba bsngo ba ni/ da ni dge ba sems can gyi don du bsngo ba/ de ltar legs gsungs zhi ba'i rang bzhin gyis/ /'gro kun sems kyi rnyog pa rab zhi nas/ /lam gol log dang dman par zhugs pa yis/ /dub pa'i sems nyid de ring ngal sos shig /ces smos te/ legs par bshad pa'i chos tshul ston ka'i zla ba dri ma med pa'i 'od zer gyi tshogs shar ba'i mthus/ 'gro ba gang dag nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas kyi lam la zhugs pa dang*/ gzhan mu stegs byed kyi lam la zhugs pa dang*/ yongs su ma rdzogs pa'i lam la zhugs pas dub pa dang*/ gzhan yang srid pa'i lam po cher zhugs pas dub pa dag gi sems kyi nyon mongs pa'i rnyog pa rab tu zhi nas/ thar pa'i nags tshal rmad du byung bar/ yon tan gyi rdzing bu me tog gi tshal bkra bas khebs par ngal gso bar shog cig ces pa'o/ /ston zla gang bas nam mkha' brgyan pa bzhin/ /cha shas rdzogs pas gsal ba'i dkyil 'khor can/ /dad brgya'i kun mu da rnams kha 'byed pa/ /de yis 'gro kun rab tu snang byed shog /sems gtsang lhun po phan bde'i rol mtshos bskor/ /tshad med bzhi ldan logs bzhi gling bzhi'i rgyan/ /dge tshogs mu khyud kyis mdzes 'jig rten gyis/ /ma lus 'gro kun nyer 'tsho'i gzhir gyur pa/

/sa gsum rol pa'i chu 'dzin zhi ba'i nang*/ /rmad byung dge tshogs char 'bab glog 'gyu zhing*/ /tshad med rnam bzhi'i 'brug sgra snyan bsgrags pas/ /phyi ma'i mu mthar phan bde byed par shog /rdzogs pa chen po sems nyid ngal gso las/ /tshad med pa bzhi'i le'u ste bdun pa'i 'grel pa'o// // mes po'i shul bzhag las/ klong chen rab 'byams kyi gsung 'bum/ (20)rdzogs pa chen po sems nyid ngal gso'i 'grel pa shing rta chen po/ stod cha/ - PAGE 420-- PAGE 421-
